kjv: who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit
note: TR imports the clause from 8:4; absent from Sinaiticus*, B, C, D*, F, G. Without it the "no condemnation" is unconditional.
auto to pneuma is grammatically neuter; the KJV's "itself" (also 8:26) follows the Greek gender, but in English reads as impersonal, against the KJV's own "he" in John 14–16.

kjv: the glorious liberty of the children of God
mine: the freedom of the glory of the children of God
note: A Hebraism; the KJV turns "the freedom of the glory" into an adjective ("glorious liberty"), which shifts the emphasis from glory to liberty.
